_note: Per-function deploy settings for .github/workflows/supabase-functions-deploy.yml. verify_jwt was READ FROM PRODUCTION on 2026-10-01 (supabase functions list), not assumed. The workflow refuses to deploy a function whose live verify_jwt differs from this file, and asserts it is unchanged after the deploy. A new function must be added here first: deciding verify_jwt is part of shipping it. apple-token, walk-leg and weather are false on purpose (their callers send the publishable key, which is not a JWT) — see each index.ts.
